correctness.rationale: Exact regular-representation cyclic decomposition proves the singular-value formula for all finite groups. Strict concavity at fixed phase forces balanced coefficients, cosine-piecewise strict concavity gives exactly the negative-root optimal phases, and elementary cotangent/cosecant sums plus monotonicity give sharp fixed-order/global minima. value.rationale: Exact two-point Fourier effective dimension is a natural first nontrivial Fourier-ratio slice on arbitrary finite groups. The theorem determines both coefficient classes, all equality cases, and a structural arithmetic reversal between smallest prime and largest realized element order in odd groups. This contrast distinguishes groups with the same cardinality and smallest prime, and supplies quantitative trace-norm baselines for sparse harmonic analysis rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
